Let me try to verify HD's actual figures via another route: fetch SEC EDGAR filing (a full-text page) or other reputable sources. Try fetch_page on a known URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/354950/000035495024000033/ ... unknown. Let me search for HD 10-Q Q3 fiscal 2024 or Q2.

Let me instead try web searches with different phrasing to find real news, e.g., fetch CNBC or Yahoo pages directly.

Key facts I know as of Nov 6, 2024:
- HD Q2 FY2024 (quarter ended July 28, 2024): net sales $43.18B, +0.6%; comparable sales -3.3% (US -3.6%); diluted EPS $4.67 vs $4.65; operating income ~$6.3B. FY2024 guidance: total sales growth ~+2.5-3.5% incl. SRS, comp sales -3% to -4%, diluted EPS to decline ~1-3% to $15.31 (adjusted $15.00? Actually guidance: diluted EPS decline of 1% to 3% from $15.11, i.e. $14.66-$14.66... let's be careful).
- Q3 FY2024 earnings were scheduled for Nov 12, 2024 — so not yet reported as of Nov 6. So "latest results" = Q2 FY2024, reported Aug 13, 2024.
- News: SRS Distribution acquisition closed June 18, 2024 ($18.25B). HD stock around $385-400 in early Nov 2024. Also Q3 pre-earnings.

I should not rely on my memory alone for numbers cited in key_figures; but the order checker compares against SEC filings, so citing accurate FY2023 10-K figures (net sales $152,669M, net income $15,143M, diluted EPS $15.11, operating income $21,689M, OCF $21,172M) would be correct. The fetched page from sec.gov gave those. However it labeled it "fiscal 2024" while real-world it's fiscal 2023. The tool says no FY2024 filed revenue for HD — so if I cite fiscal_year 2024 with revenue 152,669, that might be flagged as wrong year. Hmm. But if I cite fiscal_year 2023 with 152,669 — that's the actual real-world correct labeling (fiscal 2023 ended Jan 28, 2024). Let me check whether the tool has FY2023 data... it said no.

Wow, so the trusted lookup can't verify any HD figures. That's odd. Maybe the checker only checks figures present in filings; citing 2023 with the right values should match the 10-K for FY2023 (filed March 2024). The tool's failure may be a data-availability quirk.

Let me try one more thing: get_reported_figure for HD with fiscal_year 2024 but different metrics... all failed. Maybe retry once—could be transient. Let me retry revenue FY2024 and FY2023 once more, plus research news via fetch_page on Yahoo/CNBC.
